# Setting names

Every setting the editor shows, with its name in Mica, PrusaSlicer and OrcaSlicer. Mica's label is
OrcaSlicer's where Orca has the option (the GUI follows Orca's layout), else PrusaSlicer's.

- **Rules**: under which slicing rules (`mica_slicing_rules`, see slicing-rules.md) the row shows: `both`,
  `PrusaSlicer` or `OrcaSlicer`.
- **Merged**: one row on every printer for an option both slicers have under different names. The
  Orca key is Mica's (the PrusaSlicer counterpart is hidden); PrusaSlicer files are translated on
  import and get the counterpart written back on export (`mica_core::merged`).
- **Rule-specific**: a group with one name (Travel lift, Bridges, Cooling slowdown) whose controls
  differ by rules; the row shows only under the rules named.
- **Mica-only**: Mica's own options (`mica_*`). **OrcaSlicer only** / **PrusaSlicer only**: no
  counterpart in the other slicer.

## Merged settings

| Mica | PrusaSlicer | OrcaSlicer | Translation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Walls printing order (`wall_sequence`) | External perimeters first (`external_perimeters_first`) | Walls printing order (`wall_sequence`) | Outer/Inner = external perimeters first on, Inner/Outer = off. PrusaSlicer has no Inner/Outer/Inner: it is written as off (lossy). |
| Scarf joint seam (`seam_slope_type`) | Scarf joint placement (`scarf_seam_placement`) | Scarf joint seam (beta) (`seam_slope_type`) | None = Nowhere, Contour = Contours, Contour and hole = Everywhere. |
| Conditional scarf joint (`seam_slope_conditional`) | Scarf joint only on smooth perimeters (`scarf_seam_only_on_smooth`) | Conditional scarf joint (`seam_slope_conditional`) | Same intent; PrusaSlicer rules use PrusaSlicer's smoothness test, OrcaSlicer rules the angle and overhang thresholds. PrusaSlicer's default is on, Orca's off. |
| Scarf around entire wall (`seam_slope_entire_loop`) | Scarf joint around entire perimeter (`scarf_seam_entire_loop`) | Scarf around entire wall (`seam_slope_entire_loop`) | Identical. |
| Scarf joint for inner walls (`seam_slope_inner_walls`) | Scarf joint on inner perimeters (`scarf_seam_on_inner_perimeters`) | Scarf joint for inner walls (`seam_slope_inner_walls`) | Identical. |
| Scarf length (`seam_slope_min_length`) | Scarf joint length (`scarf_seam_length`) | Scarf length (`seam_slope_min_length`) | Identical (mm; 0 disables the scarf). |
| Scarf start height (`seam_slope_start_height`) | Scarf start height (`scarf_seam_start_height`) | Scarf start height (`seam_slope_start_height`) | A percentage is the same. An Orca height in mm becomes a percentage of the layer height (lossy with variable layer heights). |
| Scarf steps (`seam_slope_steps`) | Max scarf joint segment length (`scarf_seam_max_segment_length`) | Scarf steps (`seam_slope_steps`) | Orca counts segments, PrusaSlicer caps their length: segment length = scarf length / steps (at least 0.15 mm), steps = scarf length / segment length rounded up (lossy). |
| Label objects (`gcode_label_objects`) | Label objects (`gcode_label_objects`) | Label objects (`gcode_label_objects`), Exclude objects (`exclude_object`) | Firmware-specific = Orca's Exclude objects (M486 on Marlin, EXCLUDE_OBJECT on Klipper), OctoPrint comments = Orca's Label objects without Exclude objects. Orca's both-on (comments and firmware labels) becomes Firmware-specific (lossy). |
| Only one wall on top surfaces (`top_one_perimeter_type`) | Single perimeter on top surfaces (`top_one_perimeter_type`) | Only one wall on top surfaces (`only_one_wall_top`) | Orca's switch is All top surfaces or Disabled; PrusaSlicer's Topmost surface only becomes on (lossy). |

## Rule-specific groups

| Group | PrusaSlicer rules | OrcaSlicer rules | Both |
|---|---|---|---|
| Travel lift | Use ramping lift (`filament_travel_ramping_lift`), Maximum ramping lift (`filament_travel_max_lift`), Steeper ramp before obstacles (`filament_travel_lift_before_obstacle`), Use ramping lift (`travel_ramping_lift`), Maximum ramping lift (`travel_max_lift`), Steeper ramp before obstacles (`travel_lift_before_obstacle`) | Z-hop type (`z_hop_types`) | Z-hop height (`filament_retract_lift`), Ramping slope angle (`filament_travel_slope`), Z-hop lower boundary (`filament_retract_lift_above`), Z-hop upper boundary (`filament_retract_lift_below`), Z-hop height (`retract_lift`), Traveling angle (`travel_slope`), Z-hop lower boundary (`retract_lift_above`), Z-hop upper boundary (`retract_lift_below`) |
| Bridges |  | Bridge line width (`bridge_line_width`) | Bridge flow ratio (`bridge_flow_ratio`), External bridge density (`bridge_density`), Internal bridge density (`internal_bridge_density`), Thick external bridges (`thick_bridges`), Extra bridge layers (beta) (`enable_extra_bridge_layer`) |
| Cooling slowdown | Cooling slowdown logic (`cooling_slowdown_logic`), Perimeter transition distance (`cooling_perimeter_transition_distance`) |  | Slow printing down for better layer cooling (`cooling`), Min print speed (`min_print_speed`) |
